title: Numbers Eleven to Twenty
label: ch:hi-numbers-eleven-to-twenty
canDo: I can count from eleven to twenty in Hindi and spot the subtractive nineteen sitting inside the list.

payoff.summary: Say ओस and ऊन, pick out उ, ऊ and ओ, count ग्यारह to बीस, then read उन्नीस as 'one less than twenty', the same logic as Latin's ūndēvīgintī.
payoff.note: HI-C22-gyarah-bees is the chapter's last lesson (sequence 710) and assesses all 8 atoms it introduces: ओस and ऊन in the warm-up, the three independent vowels उ, ऊ and ओ in a pointing section, and the teens, उन्नीस and बीस.
